title: A proof of the cyclotomic conjecture and the non-existence of almost Moore digraphs
summary: For $n>2$ and $k>1$, define the polynomial \[F_{n,k}(x) = Φ_n(1 + x + \cdots + x^k),\] where $Φ_n$ denotes the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial. The \emph{cyclotomic conjecture} proposed by Gimbert (1999) exactly describes the irreducibility of $F_{n,k}(x)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ in terms of $n$ and $k$. Conde, Gimbert, González, Miller and Miret (2014) established that the cyclotomic conjecture, if true, would imply the non-existence of almost Moore digraphs - a well-known open question concerning the directed degree-diameter problem.
